== Summary ==
Identified, left to right: an unlabeled tall player in a white graphic tee and navy shorts; [[Kendall Halman]] (black polo and long hair; same face as [[:File:Kendall Halman 2020 Content Creator Award.jpg]]); [[Karl Koenig]] (long hair, a white face mask, and a Guns N' Roses Star Wars tee; same face and hair as [[:File:Karl Koenig and Kendall Halman 2022 US Nationals.jpg]] and the masked teammate in [[:File:2022 World Championship team tournament 2.jpg]]); [[Greg Shaw]] (blue Outrider Cup 2019 hoodie); [[Hayes Hunter]] (olive tee); and [[Jarad Konsker]] (maroon Deuce tee and glasses). The middle player is different in [[:File:2022 World Championship No Reverts 2.jpg]], where [[Brian Fred]] stands in that shirt.
Players in matching "NO REVERTS!" caps in front of the Players Committee banner (first of two photos).

* '''Event:''' [[2022 World Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2022-10-18
* '''Camera date:''' 2022-10-14 to 2022-10-16 (not stated)
* '''Identification:''' the people are not named in the post.
